notes.title: UPDATES(1.3) - 1 October 2021
notes.content:
UPDATES(1.3)
---------------------
- Remade the inventory system fixing many of the errors it had before.
- Created a player stats system(Agility, strength, intelligence, stamina and magic).
   The items the player equips will now will affect the stats the player has which in turn affects the players attack speed, mana regen, etc.
-Added more items to the game.
-Fixed a bug where the enemy pack does not activate.
-Fixed a bug (invisible wall) that does not allow the player to proceed through a corridor.
-Added code that saves the players weapon and loads it again after you resume the game.
-Added the code to save equipped items as well as inventory items.
-Worked on some balancing issues throughout the game.

notes.title: UPDATES(1.2b)
notes.content:
[u]UPDATES(1.2b)
[/u]
- Added the inventory support. Players will now need to open the inventory and right click on consumables instead of consuming them when moving over them in the game world.
- Added key binding.
- Added support for changing to multiple resolutions.
- Changed some elements of the UI.
- Added a highlight around the model when players move their mouse over loot chests and weapons.
- Added more powerup items that can be collected.
- Added collisions to NPC characters like ghouls etc. 
- Added more pressure pads throughout the game to unlock gates.
- Added more health to the Crypts Giant Bat.
-Fixed a few issues when using the town scroll.
- Fixed a few minor bugs.
- Added an indication of how many spiders are left on the Little girl mission.

notes.title: 11 June 2021 - Patch 1.1b
notes.content:
UPDATES(1.1b)
---------------------
- Added color coding to item pickups. Also slowed the fade speed.
- Brightened up many of the levels that where too dark.
- Added a conjuring inventory(item) panel to the conjuring table so players can see what items are needed for each category.
- Added code that scaled text tooltips based on monitor resolution.
- Added backgrounds to dialog to make the text stand out more.
- Started modifying code for controller support.
- Started adding code for a full inventory support.
- Added an overview map toggle where players can get a much larger view of the map. This makes it easier for them to see where to go.
- Fixed a bug where an enemy pack would not activate.
- Added a Town Scroll that when collected, the player can teleport to a town. The player can then recover and explore the town area, purchase items etc. Use to the teleport close by to return to the same area.
